name: axiom-protocol
description: Axiom Protocol — verifiable DeFi intelligence on 0G Chain. ERC-7857 iNFTs with encrypted metadata re-keyed via a simulated TEE oracle (software signer), strategy inference via 0G Compute, data on 0G Storage. On-chain vault settlement requires Merkle proofs (see docs/current-state.md).

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @axiom/config build && pnpm --filter @axiom/chat-runtime build && pnpm --filter @axiom/oracle build && pnpm --filter @axiom/backend build
scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @axiom/indexer build && pnpm --filter @axiom/frontend build
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist build out cache .turbo node_modules/.cache
